### American Coastal Insurance Corporation Receives Certificate of Authority for ACES Specialty Insurance Company


October 8, 2026


ST. PETERSBURG, Fla., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- American Coastal Insurance Corporation (Nasdaq Ticker: ACIC) (“the Company”, “American Coastal” or “ACIC”), the insurance holding company of American Coastal Insurance Company, today announced that its newly formed subsidiary, ACES Specialty Insurance Company (“ACES”), has received a Certificate of Authority from the Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions to transact excess and surplus (“E&S”) lines of insurance.


The Company initially plans to underwrite catastrophe exposed commercial E&S property business through ACES in Florida, Texas, and South Carolina, building on AmCoastal’s experience in coastal commercial property.


“Receiving ACES’s Certificate of Authority is an important milestone for American Coastal and marks the start of a bold new chapter for our organization’s long-term strategy,” said Brad Martz, President and Chief Executive Officer. “With ACES, we can now serve a much wider range of commercial property risks in markets we know well. We built this platform along with our in-house managing general agency, Skyway Underwriters, carefully and with purpose, and we’re excited to put it to work for our agents, policyholders, and shareholders.”


ACES expects to begin writing business on or about December 1, 2026, subject to customary regulatory, rating agency, and other operational requirements.


**About American Coastal Insurance Corporation:**
American Coastal Insurance Corporation ([amcoastal.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=CQVGwQ_pHGlGO_Gu43bbyN7VT7GPo2M_NFN08rFYrq6M2FnG5HgWo4F2EhA7Dg8guWSWJb9YJh2tW83FmNj5JPqEABgM29P9EsBAVBuGeTQ=) ) is the holding company of the insurance carrier, American Coastal Insurance Company, which was founded in 2007 for the purpose of insuring Condominium and Homeowner Association properties, Apartments and Assisted Living Facilities in the state of Florida. American Coastal Insurance Company has an exclusive partnership for distribution of Condominium Association properties in the state of Florida with AmRisc Group ([amriscgroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bcTH08G-L4C5lUFz2d0yK3MkyrZ67ZG368vxuBfthjW0-GgReoTt5iFzu11HIFxgjbzoFgNLk_GQJUFUjfPP5PbcPEOVoLBI027MOwv9bjY=) ), one of the largest Managing General Agents in the country specializing in hurricane-exposed properties. American Coastal Insurance Company has earned an “A”, (“Exceptional”) Financial Stability Rating from Demotech and maintains an “A” insurance financial strength rating with a Stable outlook from KBRA. ACIC maintains a “BBB” issuer rating with a Stable outlook from KBRA.
